summary.en: AI × Cognitive Science × Biomedical Engineering

summary.en: Using generative AI and representation learning to study human perception, memory and decision-making — and what intelligent systems can learn from them.
summary.zh: 用生成式 AI 与表征学习研究人类感知、记忆与决策，并思考智能系统如何模拟、偏离或对齐人类认知。

label.en: Dimensions of Vulnerability in Visual Working Memory
label.zh: 视觉工作记忆的脆弱性维度

summary.en: First-author work (CogSci 2025): controllable naturalistic stimuli show that abstract dimension similarity — not just image similarity — drives memory distortion, and visual dimensions are more fragile than semantic ones.
summary.zh: 一作工作（CogSci 2025）：用可控自然主义刺激证明，抽象维度相似性本身就足以诱发记忆扭曲，且视觉维度比语义维度更脆弱。

summary.en: Yuang Cao*, Jiachen Zou*, Chen Wei†, Quanying Liu†. Accepted for presentation at the Cognitive Science Society Annual Conference 2025, San Francisco.
summary.zh: Yuang Cao*, Jiachen Zou*, Chen Wei†, Quanying Liu†。Cognitive Science Society 2025 接收，旧金山。

summary.en: Two-stage generation (p(h|e) → p(x|h)) with training-free guidance; precise dimension editing in CLIP embedding space.
summary.zh: 两阶段生成（p(h|e) → p(x|h)）+ 免训练引导；在 CLIP 嵌入空间做精确维度编辑。

summary.en: Stimuli arranged on circular manifolds in concept space — decoupling image similarity from dimension similarity so each can be tested alone.
summary.zh: 在概念空间圆形流形上排布的刺激体系——把图像相似性与维度相似性解耦，可单独检验各自贡献。

label.zh: 实验一 · 图像轮 · N=100

summary.en: Image similarity drives distortion. Accuracy 0.372 (visual) vs 0.503 (semantic); bias 13.2° vs 10.1°.
summary.zh: 图像相似诱发扭曲。视觉准确率 0.372 vs 语义 0.503；偏差 13.2° vs 10.1°。

label.zh: 实验二 · 维度轮 · N=146

summary.en: Dimension similarity alone still distorts; visual–semantic gap widens (3.8°). Confirms the effect lives in the dimension structure.
summary.zh: 仅维度相似仍诱发扭曲，且视觉-语义差距反而更大（3.8°）。确认效应根植于维度结构本身。

label.en: Similar dimensions bias memory like similar images
label.zh: 相似维度与相似图像一样诱发记忆扭曲

summary.en: First validation of similarity-induced memory bias with naturalistic real-object stimuli.
summary.zh: 首次在自然主义真实物体刺激上验证相似性诱发记忆偏差。

label.en: Visual dimensions are more fragile than semantic ones
label.zh: 视觉维度比语义维度更脆弱

summary.en: Consistent across both experiments; supports schema-based semantic representation (Brady & Störmer, 2022).
summary.zh: 两个实验一致；支持语义表征受益于图式化深层加工（Brady & Störmer, 2022）。

label.zh: 情绪维度发现 · 进行中

summary.en: Lab project: can open-ended emotion descriptions be compressed into a stable low-dimensional structure? LLM word sampling → human validation → SPoSE.
summary.zh: 实验室项目：开放式情绪描述能否被压缩为稳定低维结构？大模型采词 → 人类验证 → SPoSE 降维。

status.zh: 进行中 · NCC 实验室

summary.en: Word generation → human validation (quality gate) → SPoSE unsupervised dimension discovery → cross-source / cross-culture comparison.
summary.zh: 词生成 → 人类验证（质量闸门）→ SPoSE 无监督降维 → 跨来源/跨文化比较。
产词唯一标准 = qwen3.7（全量臂 qwen3.7-plus，对照臂 qwen3.7-flash）；Qwen-VL 系词集已废弃、不作正式输入。旧 1965/2000 片段词集（平均 2.8 词/片段、人类保留率 66.9%、适宜度 4.90）属 QwenVL 时代数据，仅作历史对照。SPoSE 降维在 qwen3.7 词集上推进。
summary.en: The sole word-generation caliber is Qwen 3.7 (full-run arm qwen3.7-plus, comparison arm qwen3.7-flash); Qwen-VL word sets are retired and excluded from formal inputs. The legacy 1,965/2,000-clip set (avg 2.8 words/clip, 66.9% human retention, 4.90 appropriateness) is QwenVL-era data kept for historical reference only. SPoSE dimension discovery proceeds on Qwen 3.7 word sets.

label.zh: 全量产词成本核算 · qwen3.7-plus
label.en: Full-scale word generation cost estimate · qwen3.7-plus

summary.zh: 按 qwen3.7-plus 官方单价（输入 ¥2 / 输出 ¥8 每百万 token）与 48,175 段的实测+官方公式复核 token 核算：全量产词低/中/高三档约 ¥32 / ¥55 / ¥106，重试最坏情景 ¥299；相对 ¥1000 预算阈值余量约 18×，够用、无需分批。
summary.en: Using qwen3.7-plus list prices (¥2 input / ¥8 output per million tokens) and token counts measured/re-derived from the official formula for 48,175 clips: low/mid/high totals ≈ ¥32 / ¥55 / ¥106, ¥299 in the retry-worst case; about 18x headroom under the ¥1000 budget, so no forced batching.

evidence_refs: https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/model-pricing (fetched 2026-09-11): qwen3.7-plus, North China 2 (Beijing), 0<Token<=256K -> input ¥2, output ¥8 per million tokens; Batch half price; 1M free tokens

https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/qwen-api-via-dashscope (fetched 2026-09-11): usage.input_tokens / output_tokens / input_tokens_details.video_tokens are returned by the API

label.zh: SPoSE 输入规模实测 · 5k+ 成立

summary.zh: 对 120 部电影 48,175 段做全量过滤计数（0 API）：所有段均有非空文本、时长均≥1.6s（故『有字幕文本』与『可抽 3 帧』两项在本语料上恒真、不构成约束）。在『对齐字幕 + 时长≥2s + 可抽 3 帧 + 视频存在』口径下达标 33,484 段 = 5k 目标的 6.70×；最严口径（对齐 + 覆盖≥0.8 + ≥3s）仍有 19,811 段 = 3.96×。片段供给不构成缺口，唯一真正起作用的过滤器是时长下限（到 N≤12.7s 仍能凑满 5k）。
summary.en: Full-corpus filter count over 120 films / 48,175 segments (zero API): every segment has non-empty text and lasts at least 1.6s, so 'has subtitle text' and '3 frames extractable' are both trivially satisfied and constrain nothing. Under 'aligned subtitle + duration >= 2s + 3 frames extractable + video present', 33,484 segments qualify = 6.70x the 5k target; even the strictest reading (aligned + coverage >= 0.8 + >= 3s) leaves 19,811 = 3.96x. Clip supply is not the bottleneck; the only binding filter is the duration floor (5k still holds up to N <= 12.7s).

evidence_refs: 本机全量重扫 120 部 segments.json，两次独立循环互证（2026-09-11）；明细留存于私有记录

label.zh: 全量产词失败模式 · 短片段 400 与丢弃证据
label.en: Full-corpus word-gen failure mode: sub-2s HTTP 400 and discarded bodies

summary.zh: 48,175 段全量产词前的失败门：4 段 HTTP 400 的服务端 body 因脚本只存 str(e) 而丢失（原因不可判）；可比时长的失败段 4/4 为 <2.0s 短片段，而 ≥2.0s 仅 1/225 失败（Fisher p=4.5e-8），全量预计约 1,886 段非随机缺口；现行脚本对失败段只占位、不重试，Exp37 消费路径整段丢弃（build_manifest 29→28），且视频再压 pass2 因同路径 in/out 为 no-op（抽样 32.4% 仍以 >100KB 上传，max 486,784 B）。官方上限超标 0 段。
summary.en: Pre-flight failure gate for the 48,175-clip run: the four HTTP-400 segments have no server body because the scripts keep only str(e); all four duration-comparable failures are sub-2.0s clips versus 1/225 for >=2.0s (Fisher p=4.5e-8), implying ~1,886 non-random gaps corpus-wide; the pipeline only writes an error placeholder and never retries, the Exp37 consumer drops failed segments entirely (build_manifest 29->28), and the 240px re-compression pass is a no-op due to same-path in/out (32.4% of a 105-clip sample still upload >100KB, max 486,784 B). Zero segments exceed official limits.

status.zh: 已证据化 · 服务端具体原因查不到（缺 response body）
status.en: Evidenced; exact server reason unknown (response body not retained)

evidence_refs: 本机复算失败分布与片段时长的相关性（2026-09-11）；明细留存于私有记录

label.zh: 层4 数据获取路径 · 合规链条终检（2026-09-11）
label.en: Layer-4 data access paths: compliance-chain audit (2026-09-11)

summary.zh: 对层4 最接近来源实查『现在零动作→数据可用』的最短合规链条：CMU-MOSEI 零签署、零注册、零费用，官方只发匿名化处理特征（不发原始视频），但其 .csd 官方主机与 Drive/HF 镜像本机全部不可达；IEMOCAP 须由有权约束接收机构的官方人员（+导师）签署 Data Release Form，并禁止再分发数据及派生品，官方未公布处理时延；可即时直取的 RAVDESS/EmoBank 等不满足话语级细粒度效价+结构条件。结论：今天不存在零外部动作可用的层4 设计A 来源，两条最短链的首个动作分别是『打通出网』（执行主体=用户/网络管理员）与『机构签署人签字』（执行主体=导师/PI/院系授权人）。 另发现 Zenodo 存在第三方上传的 CMU-MOSEI .csd/pkl 镜像（10.5281/zenodo.17668236、10.5281/zenodo.17686067，open 且本机可达）：技术可达但许可是上传者自施、原始权利方未授权，IEMOCAP 镜像更违反其禁再分发条款，故不计入合规链。
summary.en: Audits the shortest compliant chain from zero action to usable data for the closest layer-4 sources. CMU-MOSEI needs no signature, registration or fee and officially ships only anonymized processed features (never raw video), but its .csd host and Drive/HF mirrors are unreachable from this machine; IEMOCAP requires an official authorized to bind the receiving institution (plus advisor) to sign the Data Release Form, forbids redistribution of data and derivatives, and publishes no processing latency; instantly downloadable sets such as RAVDESS/EmoBank fail the utterance-level fine-grained valence plus structural conditions. Conclusion: no zero-external-action layer-4 design-A source exists today; the first step of each shortest chain is either network egress (owner: user/network admin) or an institutional signature (owner: advisor/PI or authorized signatory). Zenodo also hosts third-party CMU-MOSEI .csd/pkl mirrors (10.5281/zenodo.17668236, 10.5281/zenodo.17686067) that are open and reachable from this machine: technically downloadable, but the license is self-declared by the uploader with no authority from the rights holder, and an IEMOCAP mirror would breach its no-redistribution clause, so neither counts as a compliant source.

status.zh: 2026-09-11 终检；无零外部动作可用来源；CMU-MOSEI『许可未证实』收口为『官方无独立数据许可文件』
status.en: final check 2026-09-11; no zero-external-action source; CMU-MOSEI license question closed as 'no standalone official data license exists'
